from semver import VersionInfo

# Test valid versions
print('Valid versions:')
print(f'1.2.3: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"1.2.3\")}')
print(f'0.0.0: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"0.0.0\")}')
print(f'1.2.3-alpha.1+build.4: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"1.2.3-alpha.1+build.4\")}')
print(f'1.2.3-rc.0+build.0: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"1.2.3-rc.0+build.0\")}')
print(f'10.20.30: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"10.20.30\")}')

# Test invalid versions
print('\\nInvalid versions:')
print(f'not a version: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"not a version\")}')
print(f'1.2: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"1.2\")}')
print(f'abc: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"abc\")}')
print(f'1.2.3.4: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"1.2.3.4\")}')
print(f'v1.2.3: {VersionInfo.isvalid(\"v1.2.3\")}')
"
